maya-peopleops: @samira-candidate quick ops thread: scheduling your APAC virtual interview next Wed. You said 09:00 IST preferred. Need to confirm panel, Zoom + India dial-in, captions, and any accommodations.

samira-candidate: 09:00 IST works. I need live captions, an India dial-in number, and a note that I may ask for short extra breaks.

sam-patel: 09:00 IST ok for me. How long is the loop?

jordan-lee: Plan 60-75m (30m tech, 30m product, 15m buffer). 15m prebrief at 08:45 IST. Panel: Sam, Jordan, Mei (PM APAC), Aria (ENG-US).

lisa-office: I'll set up +91 dial-in and reimbursement form. Recommend a 10-min test call the evening before to check captions.

maya-peopleops: Samira, can you do a 10-min test Tue 20:00 IST?

samira-candidate: Yes Tue 20:00 IST is fine.

calendar-bot: Tentative invite created: "Candidate Interview - Samira" 2026-06-10 09:00 IST. (Status: tentative)

maya-peopleops: I'll confirm once Aria and panel sign off. Rubric link: https://redwood.company/sheets/interview-rubric. Will add accessibility note and consent for transcript export.

lisa-office: Dial-in set: +91 22 6123 0000 (PIN 8421). Transcript export enabled; will add consent checkbox.

jordan-lee: Panel please join prebrief 08:45 IST. Prep: roles, rubric, accessibility, fallback plan (short take-home if call fails).

sam-patel: All good from me.

maya-peopleops: Final confirm will be posted here after Aria confirms PST slot. :thumbsup:
